description: A Kotlin class named LibraryFragment, which is a UI Fragment in an Android application responsible for displaying, sharing, playing, and deleting music mixes from a library. It interacts with a MixRepository for data operations and uses a RecyclerView with an adapter to show the list of mixes.

classes.name: LibraryFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays a list of music mixes, allowing users to share, play, or delete them. Implements MixActionListener for handling user actions on items.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the MixRepository instance when fragment is attached to context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView and adapter, binds data from repository, and manages empty view visibility.

methods.name: onShare
methods.description: Shares a mix file via repository.

methods.name: onPlay
methods.description: Plays a mix file via repository.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a mix file and updates the list.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears references to views to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the LibraryFragment.
